Promptfoo version 0.124.0 accepts comma-separated values for the `--filter-metadata` option to implement OR logic within one key. This enhancement allows users to specify multiple values for a single metadata key, where any of those values can match for the filter to apply.

The relevant information is stated as follows:

* "support comma-separated OR values in --filter-metadata" [3]

This indicates that users can now use a format like `key=value1,value2` to filter tests that match either `value1` or `value2` for the specified key. This change was introduced in version 0.124.0, as highlighted by the feature description linked to the commit [b7cae9f](https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/b7cae9ff5b756fdca72af54e0d3dcc25d5238d4c). [3] promptfoo/0.124.0.md (lines 20-31) > Features.
